case: MySQL/MariaDB TIMESTAMP(3) fractional storage mode semantics in UTC
contract: Each test sets the dedicated session time_zone to +00:00, clears session sql_mode for its baseline, and inserts 2024-01-02 03:04:05.789900 into TIMESTAMP(3) using both a bound parameter and generated SQL literal.
With TIME_TRUNCATE_FRACTIONAL absent, MySQL stores .790; with it enabled, MySQL stores .789.
With TIME_ROUND_FRACTIONAL absent, MariaDB stores .789; with it enabled, MariaDB stores .790.
Each write path is checked against Value::TimestampTz, UTC CAST(value AS CHAR), MICROSECOND(value), and CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(value) * 1000000 AS SIGNED).

focused.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration timestamp_fractional_storage -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

mysql_mariadb_value_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration value_contracts:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other temporal precisions and non-UTC session configurations remain untested.
Other SQL modes, consumer paths, and installed typed edits remain open.
This bounded contract does not close B3 or qualify the 0.2.0 release.
